title: Resolve maxPrimeGap_le sorry via BddAbove for prime gaps

problemStatement.plain: Resolve the maxPrimeGap_le sorry and related axioms by establishing BddAbove for prime gap sets and proving bounds from Bertrand's postulate.

knownResults.goal: All sorries resolved. Gallery entry created.

currentState.focus: Docker build verified. Gallery entry created. 10 theorems, 0 sorries, 1 axiom.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: All sorries and axioms resolved (except BHP deep result). Docker build verified. Gallery entry created with 6 annotations. 10 theorems proved: BddAbove foundation, Bertrand bounds, monotonicity, Cramer sublinearity.
insights: prime_gap_le_prev_prime is provable from Nat.bertrand (Bertrand postulate in Mathlib)
maxPrimeGap_le_half follows from prime_gap_le_prev_prime: 2d <= d+p = q <= x
cramer_implies_gap_sublinear proved via Real.log_le_rpov_div with delta=1/4 and rpow_mul
Key rpow identity: (x^(1/4))^2 = x^(1/2) via rpow_mul; x^(1/2)*x^(1/2) = x via rpow_add
nlinarith + sq_nonneg trick for a^2 <= b^2 -> a <= b (with 0 <= a, 0 <= b)
BddAbove via gap <= x is the simplest foundation for sSup-based definitions
csSup_empty (alpha := Nat) = 0 handles empty gap set cases cleanly
nextSteps: baker_harman_pintz could theoretically be proved but requires deep analytic number theory not in Mathlib
